studio.experience.signature-strip.name: Signature Strip
studio.experience.between-frames.name: Between Frames
studio.experience.between-frames.descrip: Pair contrasting expressions or poses in a diptych or triptych.
studio.experience.between-frames.intro: Try a different expression or pose in each frame.
studio.experience.motion-study.name: Motion Study
studio.experience.motion-study.descripti: Follow a series of pose cues and see one movement unfold across the page.
studio.experience.motion-study.intro: Pick a small move, like an arm sweep or a turn. Hold each pose until the shutter.
studio.motion.widest: Reach the widest part of the move.
studio.motion.transfer: Saving this frame. Get ready for the next cue.
studio.motion.contact-stack.name: Contact Stack
studio.motion.contact-stack.description: Layered, tilted cutouts frame the biggest gesture.
studio.motion.match-cut.name: Match Cut
studio.motion.match-cut.description: Four parallel cuts lead to a wider third frame.
studio.motion.ascending-cut.name: Ascending Cut
studio.motion.ascending-cut.description: A rising ribbon gives each successive pose more room.
studio.experience.mini-scene.name: Mini Scene
studio.experience.mini-scene.description: Tell a four-photo story with a setup, action, reaction, and ending.
studio.experience.mini-scene.intro: Tell a short story in four photos. Start each countdown when you’re ready.
studio.scene.setup: Setup · Show us who you are.
studio.scene.reaction: Reaction · Show how you feel about it.
studio.scene.ending: Ending · Give the story an ending.
studio.experience.time-sculpture.name: Time Sculpture
studio.experience.time-sculpture.descrip: Use a fixed camera and clear background to put three poses in one scene.
studio.experience.time-sculpture.intro: Keep the camera fixed. Start with an empty scene, then fit your entire pose inside each marked area.
studio.sculpture.empty: Empty scene · Step out of frame.
studio.sculpture.left: Left · Step fully inside the highlighted area.
studio.sculpture.center: Center · Step fully inside the highlighted area.
studio.sculpture.right: Right · Step fully inside the highlighted area.
studio.treatment.portrait-atlas.name: Portrait Atlas
studio.treatment.portrait-atlas.descript: An editorial portrait with two details from your photo.
studio.treatment.parallel-portrait.name: Parallel Portrait
studio.treatment.parallel-portrait.descr: Silver tones meet color relief in a paired portrait.
studio.treatment.film-frame.name: The Film Frame
studio.treatment.film-frame.description: A widescreen still with film grain and a clean matte.
studio.treatment.classic-filter.name: Classic Filter
studio.treatment.classic-filter.descript: Warm highlights and cool shadows for a film-style finish.
